# A policy in force since 2019 and read once

`Policy: pol-STAL` `ACTIVE`

## Purpose

To state a `review-by` that fell in 2020 and leave it there. The clause below still binds every service,
and nobody has confirmed that the organisation still wants it to.

## Scope

Every service in the estate.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                                    | Alignment |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `AGAIN` | **MUST** be read again on the day `review-by` names.      |           |
